claims.claim: Age 36 as of 26 October 2026 (FAQ)

claims.claim: Won Album of the Year at the 4 Feb 2024 GRAMMYs for Midnights; fourth win in the category; first artist to win four
claims.note: E! Online: ceremony aired Sunday Feb. 4; Midnights won AOTY; 'first artist ever to win four Album of the Year awards'. Fourth win follows from its 'trio' of earlier wins.

claims.claim: 2024 Album of the Year nominees: Jon Batiste, boygenius, Miley Cyrus, Lana Del Rey, Janelle Monae, Olivia Rodrigo, SZA
claims.note: Recording Academy page lists Taylor Swift (Midnights) as winner and exactly these seven nominees.

claims.claim: Also won Best Pop Vocal Album the same night for Midnights
claims.note: Recording Academy page: 'Taylor Swift won the 2024 Grammy Award for Best Pop Vocal Album with Midnights'.

claims.claim: TIME named her 2023 Person of the Year, announced live on TODAY on 6 December 2023
claims.note: NBC Washington: announced 'live on TODAY on Dec. 6' (2023).

claims.claim: Sam Jacobs (editor-in-chief) quotes: 'transcend borders and be a source of light'; 'No one else on the planet today can move so many people so well'
claims.note: NBC Washington quotes both sentences, attributed to Jacobs, Time's editor-in-chief.

claims.note: MBW: 'on Friday (May 30) in a handwritten letter'; lists the six albums.

claims.claim: Shamrock Capital paid Ithaca Holdings $405 million in 2020 for those masters
claims.note: MBW: 'the $405 million that Shamrock Capital paid Ithaca Holdings' (article says Nov 2020).

claims.claim: Price of the 2025 deal undisclosed; Variety called it a 'nine-figure sum'; Page Six suggested $600 million to $1 billion
claims.note: MBW: Variety 'nine-figure sum'; Page Six 'between $600 million and $1 billion'. Article correctly labels these press reports.

claims.claim: Four of the six albums re-recorded as Taylor's Version; Reputation and the debut not re-recorded
claims.note: MBW: 'successfully re-recorded four of the six disputed albums'; 'Only Reputation and her self-titled debut album remain unreleased as re-recordings'.

claims.claim: Letter quote: 'meticulously re-recorded and released 4 of my albums, calling them Taylor's Version'
claims.note: Verified verbatim on the MBW page on a second fetch.

claims.claim: Letter quotes: 'greatest dream come true' and 'purchase my music outright with no strings attached, no partnership, with full autonomy'
claims.note: 'greatest dream come true' confirmed; 'purchase my music outright with no strings attached' confirmed; 'no partnership, with full autonomy' verified verbatim on second fetch.

claims.claim: Pollstar (Dec 2023): Eras Tour grossed more than $1 billion, the first tour to pass that mark; 4.3 million tickets at average $238.95
claims.note: Pollstar-via-Intix article dated 12 Dec 2023: 'grossed more than $1 billion', '4.3 million tickets at an average ticket price of $238.95', 'first tour ever to surpass'. Estimate per Pollstar.

claims.note: Guinness article (12 Dec 2023): '$1.04 billion ... according to Pollstar', '151 shows worldwide', Elton John '$939 million ... over 328 shows'.

claims.note: Pollstar page: '149 shows across 51 stadiums', '10.055 million' tickets, gross '$2.2 billion' (estimate).

claims.claim: Forbes net worth $2 billion, real-time figure as of 26 Oct 2026
claims.note: Forbes: 'Real Time Net Worth' '$2B' 'as of 10/26/26'. Forbes does not itself use the word 'estimate' for the total; the article's 'estimate' framing is accurate.

claims.claim: Forbes breakdown: royalties and touring nearly $800 million, music catalog about $600 million, real estate about $110 million; update dated 3 June 2026
claims.note: Forbes: 'nearly $800 million amassed from royalties and touring', catalog 'an estimated $600 million', '$110 million in real estate', 'Last Updated Jun 3, 2026'.

valueNote: Adds source-level corrections a top result would miss: the Guinness vs Pollstar show count, the disputed Adele 25 figure, the press-only masters price, and the dated Forbes figure.
summary: All 30 checked claims are supported by the cited pages, including two letter quotes verified on a second fetch. Prose is plain, dated and sourced, and the disagreements are stated and cited.
